contests.office: Hall County Soil and Water Conservation District Supervisor

measures.title: Hall County homestead exemption of $10,000 from county ad valorem taxes
measures.summary: A special election on a local Act of the General Assembly. It would provide a homestead exemption of $10,000 of the assessed value of the homestead from Hall County ad valorem taxes for county purposes for residents of the county.
measures.yesMeans: Homestead owners in Hall County would get a $10,000 exemption from the assessed value of their homestead for county property taxes.
measures.noMeans: The Act is not approved and this county homestead exemption does not take effect.

measures.title: City of Gainesville homestead exemption of $10,000 from city ad valorem taxes
measures.summary: A special election on a local Act of the General Assembly. It would provide a homestead exemption of $10,000 of the assessed value of the homestead from City of Gainesville ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes for residents of the city.
measures.yesMeans: Homestead owners in the City of Gainesville would get a $10,000 exemption from the assessed value of their homestead for city property taxes.
measures.noMeans: The Act is not approved and this city homestead exemption does not take effect.
